claims.text: Nike's cost of revenue for fiscal Q4 2026 (2026-03-01 to 2026-05-31) was about $5.579 billion. It is derived as FY2026 cost of $26.487 billion minus the nine-month cost of $20.908 billion.

raw_output.summary: Nike's cost of revenue for fiscal Q4 2026 (March 1 to May 31, 2026) was about $5.58 billion ($5,579,000,000). This is a derived figure: it is the full-year amount minus the nine-month amount.
